transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
My doctor thought I should come in. She says I’ve gotten too thin. I guess my work pants are pretty loose now… but, I don’t know, part of me still feels a little relieved when the scale goes down.
Can you tell me how you feel about gaining weight or if you've been doing anything to try to keep from gaining weight?

I guess I do worry about it. If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I kind of spend the rest of the day thinking it’s going to show on me. I check myself and… feel like I need to make up for it somehow.
Have you ever tried to make up for eating more by doing things like making yourself sick, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t think I’ve done anything like that, not exactly. I just try to be careful after.
After eating more than you'd planned, do you ever restrict your food intake or exercise more than usual to balance it out?
Sometimes, yes. I’ll make dinner for my husband and my mother-in-law, and then when it’s my turn… I’ll just have coffee, or some vegetables. Maybe half a piece of toast. I tell myself that’s enough.
Have you ever made yourself sick or used anything like laxatives or diuretics after eating to try to control your weight?
No… I don’t make myself sick. And I don’t use those things, laxatives or water pills. I just… I try to be careful with what I eat.
Do you ever find yourself eating a lot in one sitting, more than most people would in similar circumstances, and then feel like you need to do something to make up for it?
I don’t think so… not a lot, like you’re saying. If I eat more than I meant to, I just feel uncomfortable with it, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big amount.
When you eat, do you ever feel like you can't control how much you're eating, even if you want to stop?
I don’t know… not really like that. I’m usually pretty aware of what I’m eating. I just don’t like feeling like I’ve had too much.
Have there been times when you felt like you lost control while eating and ended up eating a lot more than you intended, even if you wanted to stop?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I might eat more than I planned sometimes, but I don’t feel like I’m out of control or like I can’t stop.
Can you tell me about your current weight and whether it's changed recently?
My doctor says I’ve gotten too thin. I guess my work pants are looser… hanging on me more than they used to. The number’s gone down, and… part of me feels relieved when I see that, honestly.
Have you ever had episodes where you feel like you’re eating a lot in a short amount of time, more than most people would eat under similar circumstances, even if it’s not exactly what you plan?
I don’t think so. I mean… not “a lot” like that. I keep track pretty closely, so I’d notice.
Have you ever felt like you’ve eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time, even if you didn’t mean to, and then felt upset or guilty about it afterward?
Not really, no. I might feel bad if I eat more than I meant to, but I wouldn’t call it a large amount or anything like that.
Do you find yourself avoiding eating certain foods or restricting your intake because you're afraid of gaining weight, even if those foods might help you gain some weight?

Yes… I guess I do. If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I get scared it’s going to show on me. Then I spend the rest of the day checking myself and thinking I need to make up for it somehow.
Do you ever avoid eating enough, even when you’re hungry, because you’re afraid it might lead to weight gain?

Yes… sometimes. Even if I’m hungry, I’ll hold back because I’m scared if I eat something heavier, like pasta or biscuits, it’ll show on me. Then I end up checking myself all day and thinking I need to make up for it.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating because you were worried about gaining weight or feeling like you ate too much?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve felt uncomfortable after eating sometimes, but I haven’t made myself throw up.
Have you ever exercised more than usual after eating something you were worried about to try to prevent gaining weight?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’d call it exercising more… I mean, maybe I move around a bit, but I haven’t really thought of it that way.
Have you intentionally lost weight by eating less or avoiding certain foods, or has your weight loss happened without you actively trying to lose weight?

I guess… it’s more that I eat less on purpose. I’ll make proper plates for my husband and my mother-in-law, but when it’s my turn, I tell myself coffee is enough, or maybe some vegetables… half a piece of toast. Something small.
What is your current weight, and how does it compare to what your doctor considers a healthy weight for your height?

I… I’d rather not say the exact number. It’s lower than it used to be. My doctor says I’ve gotten too thin for my height, and… my work pants are hanging loose now. But when the scale is down, part of me still feels… relieved, I guess.
Do you ever engage in behaviors like excessive exercise, fasting, or severely restricting your food intake after eating even small amounts because you're afraid of gaining weight?
Sometimes… yes. If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I get scared it’s going to show on me. Then I keep checking myself and thinking I need to make up for it somehow.
